query: 各品类2025年1月份的销售额占比是多少
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fo.order_amount) AS sales_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(fo.order_amount) / SUM(SUM(fo.order_amount)) OVER () * 100, 2) AS sales_ratio
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_product dp ON fo.product_id = dp.product_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dd.year = 2025 AND dd.month = 1
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY sales_amount DESC;
